aiResearchSummary.text: Kivo Health is researching systems and methods for remote management of monitored exercise and rehabilitation in the setting of respiratory conditions. The work described in Systems and methods for remote management of monitored exercise and rehabilitation uses sensory and photoplethysmography data to guide therapy for respiratory patients, supporting telehealth delivery of structured lung rehabilitation. Overall, Kivo Health focuses on remote respiratory exercise monitoring, data driven therapy guidance, and tele-rehabilitation for chronic lung disease.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $500,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,795,570 to $7,817,751, a 1.63x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
